title: Live Airport Concourse: Restroom Refurbishment
scope: Twelve restroom blocks refurbished in an operating concourse. Blocks close in phases so passenger capacity never drops below 10 of 12.
assume: Concourse 200 m × 24 m, 10 contact stands; 12 restroom blocks (6 per side), each 12 m × 7 m with 8 WCs, 4 urinals and 6 basins.
Each phase: close & barricade, hoarding, strip-out, rough-in, finishes, fixtures, inspection, reopen.
Counter: blocks open to passengers. Airport minimum is 10 of 12. Six-day working week (night shifts not modelled).
